# CMS cap / floor (`cms-cap` v1)

Caps or floors on a constant-maturity swap rate.

**Asset class:** Rates · **Family:** option · **Product type:** `CMS_CAP`

Applies to trades whose `productType` is `CMS_CAP`. Open one with `TRD <tradeId>`.

```sutra
sutra: cms-cap
version: 1
description: Caps or floors on a constant-maturity swap rate.
match: { kind: trade, where: "$.productType == 'CMS_CAP'", priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Rates · CMS cap / floor, id: $.tradeId, with: "link($.counterparty.id, 'counterparty', $.counterparty.name)" }
strip:
  - { label: Notional, bind: "$.currency + ' ' + fmt($.notional, 'amount0')" }
  - { label: Direction, bind: $.direction }
  - { label: Trade date, bind: $.tradeDate, fmt: date }
  - { label: Maturity, bind: $.maturityDate, fmt: date }
  - { label: MTM (USD), bind: $.mtm, fmt: signed0, tone: sign, emphasis: true }
  - { label: DV01 (USD), bind: $.risk.dv01, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { label: Vega (USD), bind: $.risk.vega, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { label: Status, bind: $.status, tone: status }
panels:
  - id: terms
    kind: kv
    title: Terms
    code: TRM
    key: F2
    columns:
      - { label: CMS tenor, bind: $.terms.cmsTenor }
      - { label: Strike, bind: $.terms.strike, fmt: pct4 }
      - { label: Cap / floor, bind: $.terms.capFloor }
      - { label: Effective, bind: $.effectiveDate, fmt: date }
      - { label: Counterparty, bind: $.counterparty.name }
  - id: schedule
    kind: table
    title: Fixings
    code: FIX
    key: F3
    rows: $.schedule
    columns:
      - { label: Fixing date, bind: "@.fixingDate", fmt: date }
      - { label: Period, bind: "@.period" }
      - { label: Index, bind: "@.index" }
      - { label: Rate, bind: "@.rate", fmt: pct4 }
      - { label: Payoff, bind: "@.payoff", fmt: signed0, tone: sign, total: true }
      - { label: Status, bind: "@.status", tone: status }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - id: marketData
    kind: line
    title: "Interest rate curve: Zero rates (%)"
    code: CRV
    key: F4
    area: right
    source: "link($.discountCurve, 'ir-curve')"
    rows: points
    x: tenor
    y: zeroRate
    fmt: price2
  - id: sensitivities
    kind: hbar
    title: DV01 by bucket (USD)
    code: SENS
    area: right
    rows: $.sensitivities
    label: bucket
    value: dv01
    fmt: signed0
    tone: sign
  - id: pnl
    kind: line
    title: Daily P&L, last 20 days (USD)
    code: PNL
    area: right
    rows: $.pnlHistory
    x: date
    y: pnl
    fmt: signed0
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.nettingSet, 'netting-set')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```

## Terms

Product-specific terms live under `terms` in the trade document.

| Field | Label | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `terms.cmsTenor` | CMS tenor | text |
| `terms.strike` | Strike | `pct4` |
| `terms.capFloor` | Cap / floor | text |

## Market data

Reference fields on the trade point at the market data it is valued with. They show under *Linked entities* and drive F8 impact ("which trades use this curve?").

| Field | Kind | Selected by |
|---|---|---|
| `discountCurve` | `ir-curve` (Interest rate curve) | `ois:{ccy}` |
| `forwardCurve` | `ir-curve` (Interest rate curve) | `proj:{ccy}` |
| `swaptionVolCube` | `ir-vol-cube` (Swaption volatility cube) | `swaption:{ccy}` |

## Risk

| Measure | Field | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| DV01 | `risk.dv01` | value change for a 1 bp parallel fall in rates |
| Vega | `risk.vega` | value change for a 1 point rise in implied volatility |

The *DV01 by bucket* chart reads `sensitivities[].dv01`.

## Fixings

`schedule` rows (table), F3: `fixingDate`, `period`, `index`, `rate`, `payoff`, `status`.

## Layout notes

- The strip leads with size and dates, then MTM (emphasised) and the product's main risk measures.
- F2 is the terms, F3 the schedule, F4 the market data it is most sensitive to; F7 opens the netting set, F8 shows impact and F9 the raw document.
- Common fields (counterparty, netting set, book, trader, MTM, P&L) are described in the pack guide.
